deck.title: Problem
deck.summary: Misinformation spreads faster than verification in Bengali social channels.
deck.details: Users need fast, explainable trust scoring for posts, links, and claims without requiring domain expertise.

deck.title: Solution
deck.summary: TrustLens turns any claim into a transparent 0-100 trust score.
deck.details: Six scoring pillars, bilingual explanations, and evidence cues provide an immediate and understandable verdict.

deck.title: Why Now
deck.summary: AI model quality and local context analysis are now production-ready.
deck.details: TrustLens combines modern multi-model reasoning with Bangladesh-specific misinformation patterns.

deck.title: Product Demo
deck.summary: Paste content, get score, inspect pillars, and understand verdict.
deck.details: The same trust engine powers web, extension, and Telegram bot channels.

deck.title: Market Opportunity
deck.summary: Large Bengali-speaking social media population with high misinformation exposure.
deck.details: TrustLens is positioned for newsroom tooling, platform moderation support, and consumer trust checks.

deck.title: Business Model
deck.summary: Freemium analysis + API licensing + enterprise compliance plans.
deck.details: Premium plans include team dashboards, policy controls, SLA, and analytics exports.

deck.title: Traction
deck.summary: Production-grade MVP with integrated backend, frontend, extension, and bot.
deck.details: Core analysis pipeline, caching, and bilingual UX are complete and deployed-ready.

deck.title: Competition
deck.summary: Most tools are global-first and not tuned for Bengali misinformation patterns.
deck.details: TrustLens differentiates on localized context, explainability depth, and channel integrations.

deck.title: Unique Advantage
deck.summary: Localized AI trust scoring plus live explainability in a single workflow.
deck.details: Graph/RAG-ready architecture and bilingual delivery reduce friction for end users and evaluators.

deck.title: Go-To-Market
deck.summary: Start with judges, fact-checkers, and creators, then expand to institutions.
deck.details: Focus on transparent scoring, public trust, and shareable evidence summaries.

deck.title: Team
deck.summary: Cross-functional team across product, AI, backend, and design.
deck.details: Execution focus: quality, speed, and explainability for high-trust decisions.

deck.title: Vision
deck.summary: Become the trust infrastructure layer for Bengali digital information.
deck.details: Long-term goal: real-time trust intelligence platform for users, media, and institutions.

productOverview: TrustLens evaluates social posts, links, and article claims to produce an explainable trust score for Bengali and English audiences.
architectureMermaid:
graph LR
  UI[Web UI + Extension + Bot] --> API[Next API Gateway]
  API --> BE[FastAPI Trust Engine]
  BE --> AI[Pollinations Models]
  BE --> Cache[(Redis Cache)]
  BE --> Graph[(Neo4j Graph)]
  BE --> PG[(PostgreSQL + pgvector)]
dataFlowMermaid:
flowchart LR
  Input[User Input] --> Normalize[Parse + Normalize]
  Normalize --> Analyze[Multi-pillar AI Analysis]
  Analyze --> Score[Weighted Trust Score]
  Score --> Explain[Bilingual Explainability]
  Explain --> Output[UI Verdict + Evidence]
  Output --> Feedback[User Feedback Loop]
apiDocumentation: Exposed API: POST /api/analyze via frontend proxy. Backend route: /api/analyze with rate limit and cache-first strategy. Health route: /api/health. Auth model: currently public API with rate limiting; admin docs controls use token-based access in docs module.
dataLayer: Input may be direct text or URLs. Non-social URLs can be scraped, then analyzed. Caching is keyed by content hash for performance and cost control. Persistence layers include Redis cache, PostgreSQL/pgvector, and Neo4j graph for future enrichment.
aiLayer: AI scoring is pillar-based and weighted. TrustLens combines model calls with explainability output in Bengali and English. Graph/RAG hooks exist for future contextual reinforcement and retrieval-augmented scoring.
performance: The stack uses cache-first analysis, lightweight UI rendering, and lazy-loaded heavy modules. Documentation module uses section-level rendering, runtime health checks, and export-on-demand endpoints.
security: Core API enforces rate limiting and scoped CORS. Docs admin actions are token-protected and server-validated. Public docs visibility is enforced server-side with toggle + scheduling window logic.
analytics: KPIs include analyses performed, cache hit ratio, response time, score distribution, and section engagement in docs. This module surfaces runtime metadata and publish history as live state.

changelog.notes: Initial launch of live docs module with admin visibility scheduling.
